Process:
-J, --ada_trim                Select adapter trimming (already the default).
                                Also -E/--cutAdaptor; no value is accepted.
--adapter-action ACTION       trim or discard matching reads. [trim]

--adapter-file FASTA          Load named adapters; may be repeated.
                                Header example: >adapter1;mate=R1;end=3
--adapter-min-overlap INT     Minimum matched overlap in bases. [3]

-f, --adapter1 SEQ            Mate 1 / SE 3' adapter; may be repeated.
                                Also --adapter3-r1. Sequence only; files use
                                --adapter-file.

-r, --adapter2 SEQ            Mate 2 3' adapter; may be repeated.
                                Also --adapter3-r2. Sequence only; files use
                                --adapter-file.
--adapter5-r1 SEQ             Mate 1 / SE anchored 5' adapter; repeatable.

Report:
--allow-unqualified[=BOOL]    Permit a draft contract. [false]
                                Use =false to require qualified evidence.
                                Invalid qualification claims always fail.

Demux: --ambiguous1 FILE             Optional ambiguous SE / R1 output. [off]
--ambiguous2 FILE             Ambiguous R2; requires --ambiguous1 and PE.
--ambiguous2 FILE             Ambiguous R2; requires --ambiguous1 and PE.

--barcode-errors INT          Maximum total Hamming distance, >=0. [0]
                                Equal best sample matches are ambiguous.

--barcode-min-q VALUE         Minimum captured numeric quality: off or 0..93.
                                [off]

--barcode-r1 START:END        Inline R1 capture, 1-based inclusive positions.
                                Required in inline mode; no default range.
--barcode-r2 START:END        Optional inline R2 capture; requires PE.

--barcode-remove [BOOL]       Remove captured inline positions. [false]
                                Forbidden in index mode, even explicit false.

Process:
--config JSON                 Load {"job":"process","options":{...}}.
                                CLI overrides config; config overrides
                                defaults.
Demux:
--config JSON                 Load {"job":"demux","options":{...}}.
                                CLI overrides config, then defaults.
Dedup:
--config JSON                 Load {"job":"dedup","options":{...}}.
                                CLI overrides config, then defaults.

Report:
--consumer-contract JSON      Required consumer contract for the actual
                                producer and consumer evidence.

Process: --correction-delta INT        Required quality difference for correction. [5]
--cut-r1 HEAD,TAIL            Remove fixed bases from mate 1 / SE. [0,0]
--cut-r2 HEAD,TAIL            Remove fixed bases from mate 2. [0,0]

Demux:

--duplicates1 FILE            Optional original-order duplicate SE / R1.
                                [off]

--duplicates2 FILE            Duplicate R2; required with --duplicates1

--duplicates2 FILE            Duplicate R2; required with --duplicates1

Report:
--export FORMAT               multiqc or mgnify. [off]
                                Requires a complete source report and the

--export-out FILE             Required destination for a named export.

                                MGnify: JSON provenance plus a second file,

--extract-label SPEC          Capture a UMI/barcode; may be repeated.

                                Set explicitly only for gzip output.

                                [false]

--max-n-count INT             Maximum number of N bases. [off]

-n, --nRate FLOAT             Maximum fraction of N bases, 0..1. [off]
                                Also --max-n-fraction; rejects strictly above
                                the limit.

--memory-mib INT              Additional managed-buffer limit in MiB.
                                This is not a limit on total process memory.

--memory-mib INT              Additional managed-buffer limit in MiB.
